en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1004 - Hussain ibn Hammad narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that a man said to him: "I forget the recitation in the first rak'ah."

The man then said: "I forget in the second rak'ah as well."
Imam (as) said: "Recite in the third."

The man said: "I forget throughout my entire prayer."
Imam (as) said: "If you have remembered the ruku' (bowing) and Sujood (prostration), then your prayer is complete."
